name: praxis-guardrail
summary: The guardrail for agentic AI. Praxis sits between the AI tools you use (Claude, Codex, Cursor, any MCP client) and everything they act on — your files, the browser, and APIs — deciding allow / block / ask before each action. This free, MIT-licensed Lite edition is the on-device core: it guards filesystem actions, blocks dangerous operations, refuses your secrets, works offline, and keeps a tamper-proof audit log. Pro extends the same engine to browser and API/tool calls.
author: Praxis Guardrails
